record.question: Which of the following are phagocytic cells?
record.explanation: Answer A: Neutrophils, macrophages. Neutrophils and macrophages are professional phagocytes. Mast cells have other immune roles, and antibodies are molecules rather than cells. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK556043/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK26846/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
